parts.text:
Fig. 8.1 is an electron micrograph of part of a cholinergic synapse.
{{figure:figure_8_1.png}}
Fig. 8.1
On Fig. 8.1, use label lines and letters to label each of the following:
X - a structure that indicates that A is a pre-synaptic neurone
Y - an area that contains many voltage-gated $Na^+$ channels
Z - an area that contains both acetylcholine and acetylcholinesterase.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Some insecticides have a similar structure to acetylcholine. Suggest how these insecticides may affect the functioning of acetylcholinesterase.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Outline the roles of synapses in the nervous system.
